title: TabState
description: One browser tab's state inside a browser_session_report, derived from a single CapturedArtifact (scripts.primitive_browser_control_harness). The tab graph links tabs by opener relationships. Stores digests + bounded structured units only — never raw bodies, never secrets. candidate; serves_truth=false.

schema_version.description: version lives in metadata, never in an id or name

context_id.description: the browsing context (cookie-jar isolation unit) this tab belongs to

title.description: best-effort page title derived from bounded readable text (redacted)

opener_tab_id.description: the tab whose page linked to this tab's url in the same session; null for the seed/root tab

is_duplicate_of.description: another tab_id with an identical dom_hash/url (duplicate tab)

page_state.description: classified from login_wall / forms / downloads / api-spec references

dom_hash.description: the CapturedArtifact source_hash (sha256:...), used as the DOM digest for drift detection

screenshot_hash.description: digest of the page screenshot when a visual backend captured one; null for the stdlib/static backend

accessibility_hash.description: digest of the accessibility tree when captured; null for the static backend

auth_state.description: derived from the login wall + auth markers in bounded text

side_effect_risk.description: derived from side_effect_controls: mutating (write) vs payment/claim/regulated words (regulated)

cross_origin.description: download host differs from the page host

source.description: page_reference = the page links/embeds the endpoint (static backend); har_observed = seen in a captured HAR (live backend)

evidence_source_hash.description: the CapturedArtifact source_hash this tab was derived from
